description: The bar chart illustrates percent-point differences for two multilingual models across three probing configurations, with paired bars showing results for mBERT and XLM-R in each configuration. The horizontal axis contains the categorical configurations in left-to-right order: “hidden:[50], linear,” “hidden:[100], ReLU,” and “hidden:[50, 50], ReLU,” with no explicit x-axis label; the vertical axis is labeled “% point difference” and uses a linear scale spanning approximately from −0.2 to +0.2, with regularly spaced tick marks at about 0.1 intervals and a visible zero baseline. For “hidden:[50], linear,” the light-blue mBERT bar extends down to about −0.20, while the darker-blue XLM-R bar extends down to roughly −0.06. For “hidden:[100], ReLU,” the mBERT bar is around −0.11 and the XLM-R bar is slightly above zero at approximately +0.03. For “hidden:[50, 50], ReLU,” the mBERT bar is near −0.18 and the XLM-R bar is around −0.14. Bars are grouped side-by-side by configuration (not stacked), with the legend in the upper right mapping light blue to “mBERT” and dark blue to “XLM-R,” and there is no indication that categories are sorted by value or that any bars are specially emphasized beyond color.
